description: This PHP class 'Style' in the PhpSpreadsheet library is responsible for writing style-related information (such as fonts, fills, borders, number formats, etc.) to an XML format for an XLSX file. It manages the serialization of style objects into the appropriate XML elements and attributes used in Excel's OpenXML format.

classes.name: Style
classes.description: Handles writing style components (fonts, fills, borders, number formats, etc.) to XML for XLSX files.

methods.name: writeStyles
methods.description: Serializes the entire style component (fonts, fills, borders, etc.) into XML format to be included in an XLSX file.

methods.name: writeFill
methods.description: Writes a fill (pattern or gradient) to XML.

methods.name: writeGradientFill
methods.description: Writes a gradient fill to XML.

methods.name: writePatternColors
methods.description: Determines if pattern colors need to be written based on fill type.

methods.name: writePatternFill
methods.description: Writes a pattern fill to XML.

methods.name: startFont
methods.description: Starts a font element if not already started.

methods.name: writeFont
methods.description: Serializes a Font object into XML.

methods.name: writeCellStyleXf
methods.description: Writes a cell style (XF) to XML, encapsulating font, fill, border, alignment, protection, etc.

methods.name: writeCellStyleDxf
methods.description: Writes a differential style (Dxf) to XML.

methods.name: allStyles
methods.description: Returns all style objects in the spreadsheet.

methods.name: allConditionalStyles
methods.description: Returns all conditional styles in the spreadsheet.

methods.name: allFills
methods.description: Returns all unique fill styles in the spreadsheet.

methods.name: allFonts
methods.description: Returns all unique font styles in the spreadsheet.

methods.name: allBorders
methods.description: Returns all unique border styles in the spreadsheet.

methods.name: allNumberFormats
methods.description: Returns all unique number formats in the spreadsheet.
